title: Development of a Mobile Health Intervention to Support Functioning of Veterans With Substance Use Disorders
official: Development of a Mobile Health Intervention to Support Functioning of Veterans With Substance Use Disorders
summary: This project will involve the development, refinement, and preliminary testing of a mobile health intervention (Motivational Enhancement Therapy Skills for Veterans; "METS4Vets"), which will be delivered through a smartphone app. The intervention will aim to support Veterans who are navigating the critical transition from structured residential substance use treatment to outpatient settings.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* current Substance Use Disorder (SUD) diagnosis according to chart review
* current enrollment in VACHS residential Substance Use Disorder (SUD) treatment program
* competent to provide written informed consent
* a working smartphone with wireless capabilities or willingness to use a study-provided smartphone

Exclusion Criteria:

* current psychosis
* current active suicidal/homicidal ideation
* physical disability (e.g., uncorrected vision) that would preclude use of smartphones and/or smartphone applications
* cognitive impairment that would interfere with study participation or ability to provide informed consent, as determined by clinical interview
sponsor: VA Office of Research and Development

sites.f: VA Connecticut Healthcare System West Haven Campus, West Haven, CT
